facts.fact: Raxio Data Centre in Uganda, established 2020 by Roha Group company First Brick Holdings, is a carrier-neutral colocation facility renting space to businesses, about 400 racks and 1.5 MW, hosting the Uganda Internet eXchange Point.
Uptime Institute awarded the Raxio Data Centre in Uganda Tier III Certification in October 2020 after evaluating its design and equipment, the first Tier III certified data centre in Uganda.

systems.owner: Raxio Group (First Brick Holdings, Roha Group)
